desc: Derive and justify the marginal-cost representation and why selecting the globally cheapest marginals minimizes cost for a fixed unit count.
Implement an \(O(N)\) threshold-cost evaluation computing \(q_i=\lfloor(X/P_i+1)/2\rfloor\), total cost, and units with safe budget capping.
Design integer binary search bounds and the monotonic feasibility condition, ensuring the upper bound is infeasible even when all \(P_i>M\).
Prove tie handling after the maximum feasible threshold and compute the residual completion correctly.
Produce the final Python stdin/stdout solution with \(O(N\log(\max(M,\max P)))\) time.
